read_authority_boundary: Adapter may run read-only GitHub inspection commands for repo metadata, releases, issues, pull requests, and workflow runs.
write_authority_boundary: Adapter has no GitHub write authority and must not create, update, close, delete, dispatch, publish, or mutate anything.
freshness_check: Observed provider output must be timestamped and refreshed if release state or GitHub state changes before sign-off.
side_effect_boundary: Read-only provider calls only; no external side effects are authorized.
not_proven: Adapter readiness does not prove provider output correctness, credential safety, billing safety, write safety, production safety, or market value.
